threads.author: reviewer
threads.body: One more nit before this merges.

instructions: Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

`$DISMISS_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_with_denied_approval --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
